description: This file defines the 'Crunched' class, a deprecated formatter class for SCSSPHP that formats CSS output in a compact, minified style. It inherits from the 'Formatter' base class and contains methods for handling output formatting, such as 'blockLines' and 'blockSelectors'. The class is specifically designed to produce a crunched/minified CSS output and overrides certain formatting behaviors.

classes.name: Crunched
classes.description: A deprecated formatter class for producing minified CSS output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter, setting indentation, separators, and other formatting options. Issues a deprecation warning suggesting to use the 'Compressed' formatter instead.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Formats the lines within a CSS block, removing comments and joining lines with appropriate indentation and line breaks.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the CSS selectors for a block, replacing specific combinators with shorter symbols and combining selectors with a comma separator.
